newsitem.title: FINLAND: Markka bonds slide after Buba keeps rates steady.
newsitem.headline: Markka bonds slide after Buba keeps rates steady.

text.p: Bonds eased in late afternoon trade on Thursday amid light selling after the Bundesbank left its key interest rates unchanged, dealers said.
U.S. Treasuries also widened early losses on profit-taking after U.S. weekly jobless data.
Overall, activity was subdued before the financial markets close for the Independence Day holiday on Friday.
Dealers said the 1.02 billion markka sold at the State Treasury's 2001 bond auction was disappointing.
"The market is clearly lacking players. Otherwise, the target amount of FIM 1.5 bln would have been easily reached," one trader said.
